# Lanreenlight

> Lanreenlight is the portfolio and knowledge hub of Lanre, an AI Automation & Systems Engineer (founder of MetroHyp Digital) who builds revenue-generating systems with n8n, Python, VPS infrastructure, trading bots, and blockchain nodes. The site publishes in-depth guides, a video library, and a blog covering six topic clusters.

## Guides

- [Guides index](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/): All seven in-depth field guides — automation, VPS, trading, crypto nodes, web, app, and AI agents — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides.md)
- [n8n Tutorial: Self-Host on a VPS + AI Agents](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/n8n-automation): Building n8n workflows, Docker self-hosting on a cheap VPS, AI agent integration (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter), and n8n vs Zapier vs Make — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/n8n-automation.md)
- [Cheapest VPS Hosting: Budget Server Guide](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/vps-hosting-guide): VPS pricing and spec comparison for n8n, trading bots, crypto nodes, and web apps, plus setup and security checklists — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/vps-hosting-guide.md)
- [Forex Trading Bots: MT5 Expert Advisors & Prop Firms](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/algorithmic-trading): How Expert Advisors work, choosing EAs that aren't scams, passing prop firm challenges, and running bots 24/7 on a VPS — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/algorithmic-trading.md)
- [Crypto Node Passive Income: DePIN Setup Guide](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/crypto-node-ops): Running DePIN and validator nodes for passive income on cheap VPS hardware, from an operator running nodes since 2020 — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/crypto-node-ops.md)
- [Full-Stack Web Development Guide](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/web-development): Stack selection (React, Next.js, Vite), backend architecture, database design, VPS deployment, and Core Web Vitals — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/web-development.md)
- [App Development Guide: Idea to App Store](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/app-development): PWA vs native, React Native vs Flutter, app store optimization, monetization, and launch strategy — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/app-development.md)
- [AgentRouter Setup: Free Claude Code Credit](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/agentrouter-setup): Setting up the AgentRouter API gateway with OpenCode, Claude CLI, Claude App, Google Antigravity, and OmniRoute on a VPS — [markdown](https://lanreenlight.com/guides/agentrouter-setup.md)

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/): Deep dives into automation, node infrastructure, and market mechanics
- [Self-Hosted Coding Agents Are Going Mainstream in 2026](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/self-hosted-coding-agents-mainstream-2026): The open-source, self-hostable coding agent trend — what's happening, the stack that works, and the 30-minute setup
- [From a $500 Project to $3k/Month Retainer: The n8n Freelancer Playbook](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/n8n-retainer-playbook-500-to-3k): The upgrade path from one-off projects to recurring retainers, with the retainer scope and infrastructure economics
- [Claude Code vs n8n vs AgentRouter: When to Use Each](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/claude-code-vs-n8n-vs-agentrouter): A decision framework for the three tools — and how they combine into a self-hosted AI agent stack
- [DePIN Project Evaluation Checklist](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/depin-node-evaluation-checklist): How to tell a real DePIN node from a rug — the framework I use before committing a VPS
- [n8n Production Failures That Cost Me Money (and the Exact Fixes)](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/n8n-production-failures-that-cost-money): Four real production failures — webhook timeouts, queue backpressure, an OOM'd VPS, a double-charge — with the fixes
- [Best VPS for n8n, DePIN Nodes, and Trading Bots in 2026](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/best-vps-for-n8n-depin-trading-bots): Workload-based VPS selection — memory for n8n, uptime for DePIN, latency for trading
- [n8n Cloud vs Self-Hosted: The $/Month Breakeven in 2026](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/n8n-cloud-vs-self-hosted-cost): Real line-item cost math on n8n Cloud vs a self-hosted VPS, when the decision flips, and migration steps
- [How I Made Bless Network Pay Me $1,000 on a $5 VPS (DePIN Guide)](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/how-i-made-bless-network-pay-1000): Running Bless Network DePIN nodes on cheap VPS hardware — costs, setup, earnings, and multi-node stacking
- [The n8n VPS Blueprint: How Freelancers Charge $500+ Per Client](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/n8n-vps-blueprint-charge-clients-500): The 2026 automation freelancing playbook — what to build, how to host it on a VPS, and how to price client projects
- [Self-Host AI Agents on a Cheap VPS: Beat Claude Code & Codex Limits](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/self-host-ai-agents-on-a-vps): Why AI coding agent subscriptions hit limits, and how to run self-hosted n8n agent workflows with open models on a $4–$6 VPS
- [The Shift: Why I Left Traditional Marketing](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/the-shift-why-i-left-traditional-marketing): From ROI-driven campaigns to autonomous systems — why the future belongs to builders
- [From Digital Marketer to AI Architect](https://lanreenlight.com/blog/from-digital-marketer-to-ai-architect): The transition path from marketing to building AI systems
